label: JZ Mock C · Paper 2 · Question 11
knowledgePattern: Translate the two-triangle SSA interval into a necessary condition
solution:
The perpendicular height from B to the ray AC is ABsin30∘=x2. For an acute given angle, exactly two nondegenerate triangles require that this height be less than BC, and BC less than AB.

Thus x2<3x<2x2. Since x > 0, division gives 3/2<x<3. At either boundary there is only one nondegenerate triangle, so the bounds are strict.

A necessary condition must contain this whole successful interval. Only 1 < x < 4 does: each other option omits some permitted values between 3/2 and 3. Answer C.

hints.title: Draw the two possible positions of C
hints.body: Draw AB, then the ray from A at 30∘. Drop a perpendicular from B to the ray and find its height in terms of x.
hints.recap: An SSA triangle can have two possible positions for its third vertex.
hints.pitfall: Both triangles must be nondegenerate; a straight line is not a triangle.
hints.pause: Compare BC with the perpendicular height and with AB to find when both positions lie on the ray.

recall.reminder: For an acute given angle, compare the opposite side with the perpendicular height and the adjacent side.

hints.title: Find the full interval before choosing
hints.body: Turn those length comparisons into inequalities in x and solve them, using x>0.
hints.recap: A necessary condition must hold for every successful value.
hints.pitfall: An answer option may be wider than the exact interval you found.
hints.pause: Choose the option that includes the whole successful interval.
